input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use restriction on us. Clause 12.3 expressly confirms the opposite: we remain free to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier, and do business in any field or territory, with an acknowledgement that we have given no exclusivity, non-compete, MFC, minimum-volume or no-hire commitment. The only competitive covenant, clause 12.4 ("Vendor shall not develop or market a service that competes directly with Customer's proprietary analytics products during the term"), binds the Vendor and benefits us, so it is not flagged. Sweeps of §§ 2, 12, 13, 26 and 30 for "compete", "exclusiv", "field of use", "territor" and "restrict" surfaced no covenant limiting our business. This meets the preferred position (no restriction on Customer); no redline required.
